title: PolicyBundle
description: Cedar policy set (SEC-001) evaluated by the Policy Engine. Authorization happens outside the model: after the model generates tool arguments, before the Tool Gateway executes them.

disposition.description: INT-010: what the loop should DO when this policy determines the decision, using Synaptum's vocabulary (they own it — it is their loop that acts on it). Declared here because Cedar is binary and these are governance statements: 'refuse this step' vs 'end the run', and 'allowed' vs 'allowed once a person says yes'. Optional; omitted is DERIVED from effect (permit->allow, forbid->deny_step), which is faithful rather than assumed — deny_step is exactly what a forbid says, while terminate_run asserts more and must be opted into. A forbid cannot declare allow/require_approval and a permit cannot declare deny_step/terminate_run; either contradiction is refused when the bundle loads.
